name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAux_spec
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (f : Nat) (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
      DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Good N U →
        LT.lt.{0} (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N))
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.value N (List.toFinset.{0} U)) f) →
          And (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Good N (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAux N f U))
            (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.t N ∉
              DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.seen N (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAux N f U))

source.code:
theorem ffAux_spec (hN : N.Ok) : ∀ (f : ℕ) (U : List (ν × ν)), N.Good U →
    N.arcs.length < N.value U.toFinset + f →
    N.Good (N.ffAux f U) ∧ N.t ∉ N.seen (N.ffAux f U)
  | 0, U, hU, hf => by
      have := N.value_le_arcs hU.flow
      omega
  | f + 1, U, hU, hf => by
      simp only [ffAux]
      split_ifs with ht
      · obtain ⟨hnd, hch, hh, hl⟩ := N.augPath_spec U hN.nodes_nodup ht
        obtain ⟨hflow, hval⟩ := N.augment_flow hN U _ hU.flow hnd hch hh hl
        exact ffAux_spec hN f _
          ⟨hflow, N.augment_nodup hN U _ hU.nodup
            (fun a ha => hU.flow.sub a (List.mem_toFinset.mpr ha)) hnd hch⟩ (by omega)
      · exact ⟨hU, ht⟩
